en.name: Factory Frontier Award
en.description: A recently closed call for startups modernizing factory intelligence, robotics, and inspection workflows across industrial corridors in Latin America and South China.
en.detailSubtitle: Built for technical teams bringing software, sensing, and automation into practical manufacturing environments.
en.metaTitle: Factory Frontier Award | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Review the Factory Frontier Award for startups building industrial intelligence and automation tools.
en.overviewHtml:
The Factory Frontier Award focused on startups modernizing industrial workflows through software, robotics, and operational intelligence.

The latest cohort is closed, but the program remains a strong reference for advanced-manufacturing applicants preparing for the next cycle.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Startups building factory software, sensing, robotics, quality, or industrial-data systems.
  • Teams able to show applied relevance in real production environments.
  • Founders with a clear manufacturing or supply-chain deployment story.
en.supportHtml:
• Exposure to industrial operators and ecosystem partners.
  • Feedback on positioning for advanced-manufacturing buyers.
  • Support packaging the final competition submission.
en.processHtml:
1. Submit through the shared application page when the next cycle opens.
  2. Share industrial context, technical proof points, and traction.
  3. Coordinate review and next-step preparation with the team.

br.name: Factory Frontier Award
br.description: Uma chamada recentemente encerrada para startups que modernizam inteligencia fabril, robotica e inspeção em corredores industriais da America Latina e do sul da China.
br.detailSubtitle: Feita para equipes tecnicas que levam software, sensores e automacao para ambientes produtivos reais.
br.metaTitle: Factory Frontier Award | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Veja o Factory Frontier Award para startups de inteligencia industrial e automacao.
br.overviewHtml:
O Factory Frontier Award focou em startups que modernizam fluxos industriais com software, robotica e inteligencia operacional.

A ultima turma ja encerrou, mas o programa continua sendo uma referencia forte para candidatas de manufatura avancada.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Startups de software fabril, sensoriamento, robotica, qualidade ou dados industriais.
  • Times capazes de mostrar aplicacao em ambientes produtivos reais.
  • Founders com narrativa clara de implantacao em manufatura ou supply chain.
br.supportHtml:
• Exposicao para operadores industriais e parceiros de ecossistema.
  • Feedback sobre posicionamento para compradores de manufatura avancada.
  • Apoio para empacotar a submissao final.
br.processHtml:
1. Envie pelo formulario compartilhado quando o proximo ciclo abrir.
  2. Compartilhe contexto industrial, provas tecnicas e tracao.
  3. Coordene revisao e preparacao dos proximos passos com a equipe.

cn.name: Factory Frontier Award
cn.description: 一项刚刚结束的创业竞赛，面向提升工厂智能、机器人和检测流程的工业技术团队。
cn.detailSubtitle: 适合把软件、传感与自动化带入真实制造环境的技术团队。
cn.metaTitle: Factory Frontier Award | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 了解 Factory Frontier Award，适合构建工业智能与自动化工具的创业团队。
cn.overviewHtml:
Factory Frontier Award 聚焦通过软件、机器人和运营智能改造工业流程的创业团队。

最新一期已经结束，但该项目仍然是先进制造方向申请者的重要参考。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 构建工厂软件、传感、机器人、质量检测或工业数据系统的创业公司。
  • 能够展示真实生产环境应用价值的团队。
  • 拥有清晰制造业或供应链部署路径的创始人。
cn.supportHtml:
• 接触工业运营方和生态伙伴的机会。
  • 面向先进制造买家的定位反馈。
  • 帮助整理最终竞赛提交材料。
cn.processHtml:
1. 下一轮开放后通过统一申请页面提交。
  2. 说明工业背景、技术证明点和商业牵引力。
  3. 与团队协同完成审核和后续准备。
